4|--   2. Crea índice HNSW para búsqueda vectorial por similitud coseno

13|DECLARE
14|    ext_exists boolean;
15|BEGIN
16|    SELECT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM pg_extension WHERE extname = 'vector') INTO ext_exists;
17|    IF NOT ext_exists THEN
18|        RAISE EXCEPTION 'pgvector extension not found. Execute migration 030_enable_pgvector.sql first.';
19|    END IF;
20|END $$;

25|    current_dim integer;
26|    table_exists boolean;

35|        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tabla beauty_knowledge_embeddings no existe. Ejecutar migración 031 primero.';
36|    END IF;

38|    -- Obtener dimensión actual del embedding
39|    SELECT a.atttypmod INTO current_dim
40|    FROM pg_attribute a
41|    JOIN pg_class c ON a.attrelid = c.oid
42|    WHERE c.relname = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings' 
43|    AND a.attname = 'embedding';

51|
52|-- Paso 3: Cambiar dimensión de embedding a 1024

54|DO $$

64|        IF EXISTS (

67|            WHERE c.relname = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings' 
68|            AND a.attname = 'embedding'
69|            AND a.atttypmod = 1024
70|        ) THEN

72|        ELSE
73|            -- Recrear columna con nueva dimensión
74|            ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings 
75|            DROP COLUMN embedding;
76|            
77|            ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings 
78|            ADD COLUMN embedding vector(1024);
79|            
80|            RAISE NOTICE 'Columna embedding recreada con dimensión 1024.';
81|        END IF;
82|    END IF;
83|END $$;

85|-- Paso 4: Añadir columnas de metadata para filtrado semántico
86|DO $$

92|        AND column_name = 'category'
93|    ) THEN
94|        ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings

104|        ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings

{"content": "1|-- Migration: 046_add_rag_chunk_traceability.sql
2|-- Description: Añade columnas dedicadas de trazabilidad a beauty_knowledge_embeddings
3|-- Depende de: 035_fix_embedding_dimension_and_hnsw_index.sql (tabla base con 1024 dims, HNSW, metadata)
4|-- Objetivo: Trazabilidad mínima R3 - document_id, document_version, chunk_id, content_hash, fuente, seccion
5|
6|-- Paso 0: Verificar que la tabla canónica existe
7|DO $$
8|DECLARE
9|    table_exists boolean;
10|BEGIN
11|    SELECT EXISTS (
12|        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.tables 
13|        WHERE table_name = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings'
14|    ) INTO table_exists;
15|    
16|    IF NOT table_exists THEN
17|        RAISE EXCEPTION 'Tabla beauty_knowledge_embeddings no existe. Ejecutar migración 035 primero.';
18|    END IF;
19|END $$;
20|
21|-- Paso 1: Añadir columnas de trazabilidad dedicada
22|DO $$
23|BEGIN
24|    -- document_id: identificador estable del documento origen
25|    IF NOT EXISTS (
26|        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
27|        WHERE table_name = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings' 
28|        AND column_name = 'document_id'
29|    ) THEN
30|        ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings 
31|        ADD COLUMN document_id VARCHAR(255);
32|    END IF;
33|
34|    -- document_version: versión del documento (para futuras actualizaciones)
35|    IF NOT EXISTS (
36|        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
37|        WHERE table_name = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings' 
38|        AND column_name = 'document_version'
39|    ) THEN
40|        ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings 
41|        ADD COLUMN document_version VARCHAR(50) DEFAULT '1.0';
42|    END IF;
43|
44|    -- chunk_id: identificador único del chunk dentro del documento
45|    IF NOT EXISTS (
46|        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
47|        WHERE table_name = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings' 
48|        AND column_name = 'chunk_id'
49|    ) THEN
50|        ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings 
51|        ADD COLUMN chunk_id VARCHAR(64); -- SHA-256 hex = 64 chars
52|    END IF;
53|
54|    -- content_hash: hash SHA-256 del contenido del chunk (idempotencia)
55|    IF NOT EXISTS (
56|        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
57|        WHERE table_name = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings' 
58|        AND column_name = 'content_hash'
59|    ) THEN
60|        ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings 
61|        ADD COLUMN content_hash VARCHAR(64); -- SHA-256 hex
62|    END IF;
63|
64|    -- fuente: origen del documento (corpus, sql_seed, api, manual, etc.)
65|    IF NOT EXISTS (
66|        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
67|        WHERE table_name = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings' 
68|        AND column_name = 'fuente'
69|    ) THEN
70|        ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings 
71|        ADD COLUMN fuente VARCHAR(100);
72|    END IF;
73|
74|    -- seccion: sección/header del documento de donde proviene el chunk
75|    IF NOT EXISTS (
76|        SELECT 1 FROM information_schema.columns 
77|        WHERE table_name = 'beauty_knowledge_embeddings' 
78|        AND column_name = 'seccion'
79|    ) THEN
80|        ALTER TABLE beauty_knowledge_embeddings 
81|        ADD COLUMN seccion VARCHAR(255);
82|    END IF;
83|
84|    RAISE NOTICE 'Columnas de trazabilidad añadidas/verificadas.';
85|END $$;
86|
87|-- Paso 2: Backfill desde metadata JSONB para registros existentes
88|DO $$
89|DECLARE
90|    updated_count integer;
91|BEGIN
92|    -- Backfill fuente desde metadata->>'source' o metadata->>'fuente'
93|    UPDATE beauty_knowledge_embeddings
94|    SET fuente = COALESCE(
95|        metadata->>'source',
96|        metadata->>'fuente',
97|        'unknown'
98|    )
99|    WHERE fuente IS NULL;
100|
101|    GET DIAGNOSTICS updated_count = ROW_COUNT;
102|    RAISE NOTICE 'Backfill fuente: % filas actualizadas', updated_count;
103|
104|    -- Backfill seccion desde metadata->>'sectionTitle' o metadata->>'seccion'
105|    UPDATE beauty_knowledge_embeddings
106|    SET seccion = COALESCE(
107|        metadata->>'sectionTitle',
108|        metadata->>'seccion',
109|        metadata->>'section_title',
110|        'unknown'
111|    )
112|    WHERE seccion IS NULL;
113|
114|    GET DIAGNOSTICS updated_count = ROW_COUNT;
115|    RAISE NOTICE 'Backfill seccion: % filas actualizadas', updated_count;
116|
117|    -- Backfill content_hash desde metadata->>'contentHash' o metadata->>'content_hash'
118|    UPDATE beauty_knowledge_embeddings
119|    SET content_hash = COALESCE(
120|        metadata->>'contentHash',
121|        metadata->>'content_hash',
122|        'unknown'
123|    )
124|    WHERE content_hash IS NULL;
125|
126|    GET DIAGNOSTICS updated_count = ROW_COUNT;
127|    RAISE NOTICE 'Backfill content_hash: % filas actualizadas', updated_count;
128|
129|    -- Backfill chunk_id desde metadata->>'chunkIndex' + content_hash prefix, o content_hash
130|    -- Para chunks existentes, usamos content_hash como chunk_id si está disponible
131|    UPDATE beauty_knowledge_embeddings
132|    SET chunk_id = COALESCE(
133|        content_hash,
134|        'unknown'
135|    )
136|    WHERE chunk_id IS NULL;
137|
138|    GET DIAGNOSTICS updated_count = ROW_COUNT;
139|    RAISE NOTICE 'Backfill chunk_id: % filas actualizadas', updated_count;
140|
141|    -- Backfill document_id desde metadata->>'sourceFile' o title prefix
142|    UPDATE beauty_knowledge_embeddings
143|    SET document_id = COALESCE(
144|        metadata->>'sourceFile',
145|        metadata->>'source_file',
146|        split_part(title, ' - Parte ', 1),
147|        'unknown'
148|    )
149|    WHERE document_id IS NULL;
150|
151|    GET DIAGNOSTICS updated_count = ROW_COUNT;
152|    RAISE NOTICE 'Backfill document_id: % filas actualizadas', updated_count;
153|
154|    -- Backfill document_version default
155|    UPDATE beauty_knowledge_embeddings
156|    SET document_version = '1.0'
157|    WHERE document_version IS NULL;
158|
159|    GET DIAGNOSTICS updated_count = ROW_COUNT;
160|    RAISE NOTICE 'Backfill document_version: % filas actualizadas', updated_count;
161|END $$;
162|
163|-- Paso 3: Índices para trazabilidad y consultas frecuentes
164|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_beauty_knowledge_document_id 
165|ON beauty_knowledge_embeddings(document_id);
166|
167|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_beauty_knowledge_chunk_id 
168|ON beauty_knowledge_embeddings(chunk_id);
169|
170|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_beauty_knowledge_content_hash 
171|ON beauty_knowledge_embeddings(content_hash);
172|
173|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_beauty_knowledge_fuente 
174|ON beauty_knowledge_embeddings(fuente);
175|
176|CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS idx_beauty_knowledge_document_version 
177|ON beauty_knowledge_embeddings(document_id, document_version);
